unit: Physician encounter up to proposal, not final system diagnosis
classification_note: Exploratory documentary quality by one AI assessor; no validated total score; no medical adjudication. A brief emergency history may be appropriate. Differences in source completeness and ability to answer limit classification. Summary partial includes a plan/partial recapitulation; explicit patient-confirmed history summary was absent in 12.
methodological_corrections: reported patient_exchanges mixes initial physician and reviewer followup
A question mark is not a clinical question count
No reference diagnosis used to determine quality, but the review is not claimed blind
No closed-case individual labels, content, paths or hashes exported
unresolved_fields: Clinical adequacy of questions, urgency, management and possible missed opportunities require physician review.
